target.title: Build, deploy, publish, and install the fixed version
target.test: The fixed package builds, deploys, publishes as 0.1.41, and installs from Verdaccio.

steps.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable, yarn build, and npm run deploy.
steps.expected: All commands exit 0 and Docker compose refresh completes.

steps.instruction: Publish @neurondev/ndx-core@0.1.41 and @neurondev/ndx@0.1.41 to Verdaccio, then install @neurondev/ndx@0.1.41 into a clean prefix.
steps.expected: npm view returns 0.1.41 for both packages and installed ndx/ndxserver bins report 0.1.41.

target.passCriteria: The fixed version is available from Verdaccio and install verification passes.

target.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable, yarn build, and npm run deploy.
target.expected: All commands exit 0 and Docker compose refresh completes.

steps.descript: Build and deploy verification completed successfully.
evidence: yarn build exited 0 across all four packages.
Deploy built hika00/ndx-sandbox:0.1.1 and started/stopped/removed compose container ndx-deploy-56648-ndx-sandbox-1.

target.instruction: Publish @neurondev/ndx-core@0.1.41 and @neurondev/ndx@0.1.41 to Verdaccio, then install @neurondev/ndx@0.1.41 into a clean prefix.
target.expected: npm view returns 0.1.41 for both packages and installed ndx/ndxserver bins report 0.1.41.

steps.descript: The fixed version was published and installed from Verdaccio.
evidence: Clean prefix install from Verdaccio added 2 packages.
Installed package regression returned a JSON tool error output for read_mcp_resource instead of throwing.

result.descript: The fixed version is published, installable, and contains the tool error containment fix.
evidence: Installed 0.1.41 bins and installed core regression passed.
